messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightworks.com>
Cc: BrightWorks RevOps <revops@brightworks.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWorks QBR heatmap + renewal risk items (exec attention)

Team,

As we prep for BrightWorks' QBR (scheduled 2028-08-02), I pulled together a focused heatmap and a short risk register so leadership can triage exec attention items quickly. Attached: BrightWorks_QBR_Heatmap_2028-07-24.xlsx and a draft Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (redlines noted).

Top asks for execs:
- Immediate: approval to offer a 10% one-time onboarding credit if they sign the 24-month SOW by 2028-08-15. This is to mitigate the usage gap they flagged.
- Monitoring: agree to 2-week cadence for quality regressions tied to the workload in cluster "bw-prod-north". If error rate > 2.5% we execute fallback policy.
- Escalation: BrightWorks has asked for a 99.9% latency SLO on their high-priority routes for the renewal window — current infra plan shows 99.7% on peak. Need exec blessing for temporary burst capacity (Dedicated pool) to cover the month of August.

BrightWorks signals: usage is up 35% M/M on embeddings, but token density per request is down (they've moved to shorter prompts). RevOps notes a potential procurement hold if legal doesn't sign the revised data retention clause.

Jordan — can you validate the heatmap numbers (rows = severity lanes) and confirm whether the Dedicated burst option (cost delta estimate included in the attached spreadsheet) buys us the margin to not change model variants? Please cc Rishi on numbers so we can fold into pricing ask.

Marissa — draft an exec one-pager summarizing the three options (credit, burst, model-variant fallback) for the CTO/COO review. Keep it under one page.

Elena / RevOps — can you confirm the procurement contact and timing for legal redlines? If procurement is involved we may need procurement@brightworks.com on the next thread.

Thanks — will synthesize into the exec digest after replies.

— Naomi

- Procurement contact is Mark Liao (mark.liao@brightworks.com) and I've looped him in. He is the gate for the SOW timeline.
- Legal flagged the data retention clause; revops will push back on the 24-month retention and ask for 12 months with auditability.
- The execs will want cost delta options on the burst vs model-variant tradeoff — happy to take a short call to walk through.

I burned a slot on Wed 2028-07-26 10:00 PT for a 30-min sync; if that works for your team we can keep it.

Naomi / team — attached is a one-page heatmap summary (see Exec_Digest_Brief.txt attached inline here) and a quick cost table. Highlights:
- Heatmap: 4 customers signals in "high" lane: latency SLO gap, legal retention, onboarding churn risk (pilot cohort), and billing accuracy questions.
- Cost for Dedicated burst (GPU pool) for 4 weeks: estimated incremental $24k — this preserves current model family and keeps quality stable.
- Variant fallback (quantized Llama-2 variant): estimated savings $18k but risk of subtle quality regressions on their prompt family.

My recommendation for execs: approve a capped $20k transient burst budget + conditional 10% onboarding credit if they sign by 2028-08-15; communicate that if regressions appear we will auto-fallback and notify BrightWorks with logs.

Next steps I took: created HubSpot note (id BW-2027-42) and linked the heatmap; pricing table is row 2 in the spreadsheet.

Thanks all — good progress. Quick synthesis for the exec slate: 
1) Approve transient burst cap: $20k for up to 30 days, tied to measurable latency improvements (we'll confirm telemetry).
2) Offer conditional 10% onboarding credit if SOW signs by 2028-08-15 and procurement confirms no further legal blocks.
3) If legal forces 12-month retention, product will require configuration changes; Rishi please estimate impact on audit logs and cost by EOD Fri 2028-07-27.

Jordan / Marissa: please produce the one-pager (Marissa) and a briefing slide for the exec 5-min slot (Jordan) by EOD 2028-07-26. We'll circulate to CTO/COO with a single recommended motion and a fallback plan.

Elena / Mark: confirm Wed 2028-07-26 10:00 PT call or propose an alternate time.

I'll compile the final exec digest and route to the leadership slack channel when complete.

— Naomi
